entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators"), same as lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's identical check for the root-only sibling composition (histogram_native_mixed_or_aggregate.go) and lowerSumOrAvgMixedOrSubqueryOuterFn's identical check for the aggregation-inside-the-subquery sibling (histogram_native_mixed_or_subquery_aggregate_range_fn.go) — b is the SAME mixedExpHistogramSetOp-matched `or` BinaryExpr those two composers check, which the parser can never hand a `bool` modifier.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: subquery step must be positive, got %s
entries.rationale: the PromQL parser rejects negative subquery steps; zero is the valid default handled before this guard — the same reasoning lowerSumOrAvgMixedOrSubqueryOuterFn's identical check (histogram_native_mixed_or_subquery_aggregate_range_fn.go) already rests on for the same sub.Step field.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: histogram-valued subquery requires query eval-time context (use LowerAt)
entries.rationale: query handlers always supply evaluation context through LowerAt or LowerAtRange; only the raw test and tooling Lower entry can omit it, and sumOrAvgOverMixedOrSubqueryFoldFn's own subqueryHasEvalAnchor check already declines to match in that case — subqueryHasEvalAnchor is false exactly when subqueryGridCtx reports subqueryGridUnavailable, which is the state this guard tests — so this branch is unreachable even from that entry point, the identical reasoning lowerSumOrAvgMixedOrSubqueryOuterFn's own identical check (histogram_native_mixed_or_subquery_aggregate_range_fn.go) already rests on.
